threshold_admission.rationale: Prospective conservative adoption: selection-minus-fit RMSE must be at most min(inherited E1/E2 delta_g, 10% of fit RMSE). This tightens the inherited absolute criterion for small-scale panels. A zero fit RMSE is degenerate. Coverage, width, bias, slope and consistency tolerances are explicit scientific design choices fixed before new data, not original-guide numerical mandates; no institutional ratification is inferred. The final protocol must bind the exact configuration hash before test opening.

sources.facts: E3 guide original PDF SHA d6048aebd7b3db85a59231a5a89b01bc3f8ad8cb581a96b462e341d21ff1f364; sections8.4.3-8.4.6,8.7.3; pp24,28. Effect d>=0.2, beat trivial baseline, gap below margin, calibration/residuals and test-selection consistency; no numeric coverage/width tolerance supplied.

Section2.2 preserves the inherited E1/E2 absolute sigma7 RMSE delta=0.00025772842664981106 and draft delta_g with the same numeric value, explicitly requiring justification of the candidate gap. This is not a universal guide tolerance and is not the new relative 2% margin.

calibration.quantile: ceil((n+1)*level)-th ordered absolute calibration residual; unavailable when rank>n
calibration.coverage_ci: marginal chronological stationary-bootstrap interval, no iid/binomial or exchangeable guarantee

residuals.bds_reason: Raw overlapping-label residuals need not be iid. BDS can be explicitly preregistered as an iid diagnostic; it is not a calibration certificate.

robustness.stress_contract: Requires predeclared scenario identity and already saved post-seal predictions for every method; assessment never perturbs inputs or calls a model.
robustness.nadeau_bengio: not_applicable: no repeated random train/test partitions; use dependence-aware temporal covariance and block resampling
